summary: Iter15 frontend-only review of upgraded Noldus 14-scene SRS/CPS/EOS demo at /demo/noldus. Verified hero copy ('Noldus measures behavior. BodyIQ-AI defines it. CreatorBoostAI executes on it.', '10-minute', '(SRS · CPS · EOS)', 'Anatomical. Measurement-based. Objective.'), Start screen ('Run the 14-scene Noldus walkthrough', 'Approximately 9 to 10 minutes'), Story arc bullets covering SRS/CPS/EOS clusters + Subjective vs Structured + 'Up to 96% non-subjective · 98% signal-level accuracy', Start Demo button starts prefetch and reaches narration state. Personalization at /demo/noldus?name=Lucas&company=Noldus rendered 'WELCOME, LUCAS FROM NOLDUS.' (data-testid='noldus-personalized-greeting' AND 'noldus-start-personalized' both present). Homepage CTAs hero-cta-enterprise-demo + hero-cta-live-system both navigate to /demo/noldus. Top nav-noldus → /demo/noldus. Mobile (375x812) no horizontal overflow, start button visible. Backend smoke: POST /api/tts/speak {voice:nova} returns 200 audio/mpeg 35KB. POST /api/share-demo {demo_type:noldus} returns 202 with sent:false (Resend graceful-degrade, expected). FOUND CRITICAL ISSUE: Scene 13 'Training Replay System' (TrainingPreviewStage, lines 1262-1264 of NoldusDemoPage.jsx) still hardcodes forbidden subjective labels 'Cognitive gap detected' and 'Negotiation friction · escalating' in its timeline overlay — these labels MUST be replaced with structured signal cluster IDs per the SRS/CPS/EOS rewrite spec. Also static text body of /demo/noldus does not literally contain the bullet 'SRS · CPS · EOS structured framework' (it says 'SRS · CPS · EOS — the structured signal framework' with em-dash in story arc list and 'SRS · CPS · EOS STRUCTURED FRAMEWORK' as a feature checkbox; semantically equivalent but spec wording differs slightly). Auto-plays / Voice: Nova line is rendered as styled uppercase ('AUTO-PLAYS · ~10 MIN · VOICE: NOVA') — innerText comparison failed for exact-case match but content is present (CSS text-transform). Did not run full 10-minute scene-by-scene playback to verify cluster-stage-srs/cps/eos and accuracy-closing-stage live DOM rendering — relied on JSX source review (CLUSTER_DEFS at line 905-948 + ClusterDetectStage at line 950-1019 + AccuracyClosingStage at line 1282-1346) which confirms all required fields (Cluster ID, SRS-1142/CPS-2073/EOS-3408, AU 4/AU 7/AU 1/AU 15, intensity, classification badges, 'up to 96%', 'up to 98%', 'non-subjective', 'signal-level', closing slate 'Noldus measures.' / 'BodyIQ-AI defines.' / 'CreatorBoostAI executes.') are present and properly wired with data-testid='cluster-stage-srs|cps|eos' and data-testid='accuracy-closing-stage'.

rca of the issue: Scene 13 TrainingPreviewStage was a pre-existing legacy component (Training Replay System) that rendered a hardcoded 5-row mock signal timeline. When the SRS/CPS/EOS rewrite was applied to SCENES narration text and to the new Stage components (Subjectivity/Framework/Comparison/ClusterDetect/AccuracyClosing), the dev did not refactor this component's hardcoded timeline strings. Reproduction: scroll source NoldusDemoPage.jsx to lines 1262-1266 OR autoplay demo for ~9 min until Scene 13 ('Training Replay System') renders. Mitigation: replace the array literal entries with structured cluster sigs (SRS-1142 / CPS-2073 / EOS-3408 + AU codes + classification) so vocabulary is consistent with the rest of the rewrite.
